source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
During the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), when an attack targets a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours up to 6" from this model, this model may use this ability. Then, until the phase ends, each time a melee attack destroys a model in that unit, if the model is yet to fight this phase, roll 1 D6. On a 2+:

- the **destroyed** model stays in play
- it may fight when the attacking unit completes its attacks
- afterwards it is removed from play

trigger.event: attack targets friendly DEATH GUARD unit

effect.eachRecipient: model in targeted friendly DEATH GUARD unit
effect.trigger: destroyed by melee attack before fighting
successEffect: fight after attacking unit finishes its attacks
